tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Before the procurement of additional quantities of equipment to fulfill a mission need, the Administrator, to the extent practicable, shall utilize any existing units in the Administration’s inventory to meet that need.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Administrator shall establish a process for tracking—
the location of security-related equipment in the inventory under subsection (a);
the utilization status of security-related technology in the inventory under subsection (a); and
the quantity of security-related equipment in the inventory under subsection (a).

children.heading: Internal controls
children.text: The Administrator shall implement internal controls to ensure up-to-date accurate data on security-related technology owned, deployed, and in use.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Administrator shall establish logistics principles for managing inventory in an effective and efficient manner.

children.heading: Limitation on just-in-time logistics
children.text: The Administrator may not use just-in-time logistics if doing so—
would inhibit necessary planning for large-scale delivery of equipment to airports or other facilities; or
would unduly diminish surge capacity for response to a terrorist threat.
